theorem final_dev_0145 (a b : ℤ) (h : a^5 - b^5 = 120) : a - b = 1 := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0145 (a b : ℤ) (h : a^5 - b^5 = 120) : a - b = 1 := by
  have h1 : a^5 = b^5 + 120 := by rw [h]
  have h2 : (a - b) * (a^4 + a^3 * b + a^2 * b^2 + a * b^3 + b^4) = 120 := by
    rw [h1]; ring
  have h3 : a - b ≠ 0 := by
    intro contra
    have h4 : a^5 = b^5 := by rw [contra]
    have h5 : 120 = 0 := by rw [h4]; ring
    contradiction
  have h6 : a - b = 1 ∨ a - b = -1 := by
    rw [← h3]; linarith
  have h7 : a - b = 1 := by
    have h8 : 1 * (a^4 + a^3 * b + a^2 * b^2 + a * b^3 + b^4) = 120 := by
      rw [h6]; exact h2
    have h9 : a^4 + a^3 * b + a^2 * b^2 + a * b^3 + b^4 > 0 := by
      linarith
    have h10 : 1 * (a^4 + a^3 * b + a^2 * b^2 + a * b^3 + b^4) > 0 := by
      linarith
    have h11 : 120 > 0 := by
      norm_num
    have h12 : 120 = 1 * (a^4 + a^3 * b + a^2 * b^2 + a * b^3 + b^4) ∧ 120 > 0 := by
      exact ⟨h8, h11⟩
    have h13 : a - b = 1 := by
      rw [h6]; exact h12
    exact h13
  exact h7
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0145 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0145 := by
